slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplay/muted/loop/playsInline background video behind the liquid-glass hero; object-cover fills the viewport and is the template's only source of motion.

mechanic: A single full-screen sticky hero layering a translucent liquid-glass navbar and bottom-left copy over a fullscreen looping object-cover background video, where all motion comes from the video and CSS transition-colors hovers.
techDelivery: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS, icons via lucide-react, with custom .liquid-glass CSS (backdrop-filter blur + mask-composite gradient-border pseudo-element) and Geist imported from Google Fonts.
reskinNotes: Copy is hardcoded in JSX markup (headline, body, nav labels, CTA labels). The frosted-glass look is hex/rgba baked into the .liquid-glass class and its ::before gradient-border in index.css (white-on-dark assumption), not Tailwind tokens — reskinning to a non-white palette requires editing that CSS plus the white/black Tailwind utility classes (bg-white, text-black, text-white/60, bg-white/15) throughout App.tsx. Geist is loaded by a hardcoded Google Fonts URL and applied via a global `*` font-family rule.
